target.statement: RHO-1-Math 1.1B achieves 29.8% few-shot accuracy on GSM8K after continual pretraining on 9B selected tokens from OpenWebMath.
target.dataset: OpenWebMath (14B tokens) for pretraining; GSM8K for evaluation

compute.basis: The target requires training a reference model on 0.5B high-quality math tokens, scoring 14B tokens, and then training a 1.1B model on 9B selected tokens. The paper reports using 32 H100 GPUs for 3.5 hours for 15B tokens; scaling to 9B tokens on a single GPU would take days, and the full pipeline (reference model training, scoring, selective training) is far beyond a few hours on a laptop.

blockers: No code or model release found
Requires training a reference model and a 1.1B model on billions of tokens
Needs GPU cluster (32 H100s in paper)
High-quality math reference data (0.5B tokens) is not publicly released
title: Rho-1: Not All Tokens Are What You Need
